incompatibilities.title: Entry point is outside .text
incompatibilities.detail: tools/lift.py keeps only the section named .text (0x00401000..0x00B603FB). The entry point 0x01FCA510 is in Sitext. tools/genall.py seeds discovery at that address and then stops, because the walk leaves .text immediately.

incompatibilities.title: No base relocations
incompatibilities.detail: IMAGE_FILE_RELOCS_STRIPPED is set and the base-relocation directory is empty. tools/reloc2.py reads an unnamed section, and this file has 0 unnamed sections, so it cannot write out/relocs.txt. tools/genall.py discovers functions from those fixup slots. With none, the only seed is the entry point.

incompatibilities.title: More than one executable section
incompatibilities.detail: The lifter never reads these executable ranges: Stext RWX 0x018B5000..0x01FC6C20, Sitext R-X 0x01FC7000..0x01FCD910, Srdata R-X 0x01FCE000..0x02038EA4, Sdata RWX 0x02039000..0x022BD6F8, .securom RWX 0x022C4000..0x024A40D6. Stext and Sdata have entropy 8.00 and no MSVC frame prologues, so their bytes are not an x86 image the lifter can translate. A section is named .securom. This report does not unpack or emulate it.

incompatibilities.title: Image does not fit the guest map
incompatibilities.detail: Image base 0x00400000 matches SPEED2.EXE, but the image runs 0x00400000..0x024A5000 (32.6 MB). The runtime treats 0x00400000..0x00932000 as the image and places other regions on top of the rest. NFSU2 image window (runtime/heap.c) overlaps 0x00400000..0x00932000; server.dll (docs/web/DESIGN.md) overlaps 0x00A00000..0x00A58000; module heaps overlaps 0x01000000..0x024A5000. Also inside the image: 0x00BE0000 (Winsock hostent buffers), 0x00C00000 (thread environment blocks). The image ends at 0x024A5000, before the main stack at 0x05000000, the thread stacks, and the guest heap at 0x08000000.

incompatibilities.title: Dynamic Visual C++ 2005 runtime
incompatibilities.detail: The import table binds MSVCR80.dll, MSVCP80.dll. SPEED2.EXE links its CRT into the exe. runtime/win32.c pops nargs for every import (`c->esp += 4 * nargs`, the stdcall convention). A cdecl CRT call cleans the stack in the caller, so a non-zero nargs here would pop twice. tools/argcount.py's KNOWN table has no CRT exports.

incompatibilities.title: Import set is not the SPEED2 set
incompatibilities.detail: 394 imported functions are absent from tools/argcount.py KNOWN (356 names). DLLs with no name in that table: d3dx9_34.dll, XINPUT1_3.dll, SETUPAPI.dll, VERSION.dll, SHLWAPI.dll, OLEAUT32.dll, MSVCR80.dll, MSVCP80.dll, CRYPT32.dll, imagehlp.dll, WINTRUST.dll, ole32.dll, RPCRT4.dll, WSOCK32.dll. gen.sh runs argcount.py with STRICT=1 for a second module and exits on an unknown name.

incompatibilities.title: TLS directory is not loaded
incompatibilities.detail: A TLS directory is present. runtime/mem.c mem_load_pe copies sections and does not walk TLS callbacks.

incompatibilities.title: Stack commit is larger than a browser worker stack
incompatibilities.detail: The optional header asks for 4096 KB of stack commit and 8192 KB reserved. docs/web/DESIGN.md records that a Chrome worker stack is about 1 MB and cannot be raised.

incompatibilities.title: No Rich header and no standard DOS stub
incompatibilities.detail: The MSVC linker product stamp is absent, and the DOS stub is not the usual "This program cannot be run in DOS mode" stub. Compiler identity comes from the import DLLs, the frame prologues in .text, and the debug path instead.
